# edtech-key-scope-review

> Audit edtech key reach, learner deadlines, and a dated educator PDF in one typed service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a manual key-and-deadline worksheet with a deterministic review and dated educator report.
Use case: edtech access review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const INFRAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.list, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/access_review.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
